question: Do the research package's 957 event-day gains, and its T+1/T+5/T+20 forward returns, reproduce from an independent source (Alpaca SIP official closes), and how many of its 271 rows without computed prices can that source recover?

inputs.package_location: private research intake (outside git); inputs are identified by sha256 only

source.asof: the event date, so a later rename resolves to the entity that traded on that date
source.rate_limit_observed: X-RateLimit-Limit 10000 per minute on this account's data API (2026-09-24 probe); this run self-limits to 20 requests per second

official_close_rule: the day's closing-auction record with condition 6 (closing print)
else a condition M record on the exchange of the day's condition O opening record
else the day's daily bar close (flagged bar_close_fallback)
gain_definition: official close on the event date divided by the official close on the latest earlier trading date that has one, minus 1, in percent, from raw prices. When the ratio of raw to split-adjusted daily closes differs between those two dates (a split or reverse split between them), both closes are divided by their date's ratio before the gain is taken, and the row is flagged split_between.
forward_return_definition: split-adjusted daily bar close N trading days after the event date divided by the event date's split-adjusted daily bar close, minus 1, in percent, for N = 1, 5, 20

package_reference.event_gain: Computed_Gain_Pct when Status is OK, else Gain_Pct_Dataset (the package's catalogued gain)

symbol_resolution: Ticker_Used when present, else Ticker, with asof = the event date
if that returns no event-date data: the alias-map Alias_Symbol for the same Date and Ticker, with asof = the event date

tolerance.basis: both sources record official closes to the cent, so a correct pair differs only by rounding; the forward-return band is wider because the two sources' split-adjustment factors are applied independently

verdicts.match: package had computed prices (Status OK) and the gains agree within tolerance
verdicts.mismatch: package had computed prices and the gains disagree
verdicts.recovered_match: package had no computed prices; Alpaca yields a gain that agrees with Gain_Pct_Dataset
verdicts.recovered_mismatch: package had no computed prices; Alpaca yields a gain that disagrees with Gain_Pct_Dataset
verdicts.no_source_data: no event-date close from any resolved symbol
verdicts.no_prev_close: an event-date close but no earlier close in the window

outputs.committed: results JSON with per-event gains, differences, verdicts and source flags (no raw prices), summary counts, the snapshot's sha256 and the request log
outputs.private: the snapshot of raw API responses (SIP prices), kept outside the repository because of market-data redistribution terms

reproduction.deterministic: compare: the same snapshot and package CSVs give byte-identical results
reproduction.re-runnable: fetch: a later fetch can differ if Alpaca revises history; compare two snapshots by their result tables

not_measured: whether an event's catalyst tag, story or causal claim is right
intraday behaviour (halts, VWAP, premarket), volume multiples and float figures
events whose symbols Alpaca cannot resolve
overturn: If the independent source disagrees with the package on more than 5% of rows that both cover, the package's price-derived statistics (chapters 15, 17, 19, 20 and the forward-return tables) are treated as unverified until each mismatch is adjudicated against a third source.
